criteria.test_rationale: Fresh source, route, migration, and diff inspection is decisive planning evidence; no product test is required to establish the starting baseline.
Correct cohort eligibility and optional orientation are critical invariants; cheaper non-test inspection is insufficient because client lifecycle and viewport behavior must execute.

Checklist progress from qualifying user-domain state and mutation context is a critical invariant; cheaper non-test inspection is insufficient because seeded presence/opens, mutations, imports, and checklist derivation must execute.
Capability-correct contextual targeting is a critical invariant; cheaper non-test inspection is insufficient because route, data, viewport, and feature states must execute.
Single focus ownership and accessible user control are critical invariants; cheaper non-test inspection is insufficient because keyboard, modal, reflow, and restoration behavior must execute.
Monotonic durable state under retries and races is a critical invariant; cheaper non-test inspection is insufficient because D1 transitions and conflicts must execute.
Row-preserving migration and lifecycle integrity are critical invariants; cheaper non-test inspection is insufficient because foreign keys, holds, backfill, and deletion ordering must execute.
Server-derived scope and tenant-data non-disclosure are critical invariants; cheaper non-test inspection is insufficient because negative authorization and serialization paths must execute.
Public and ineligible bundle exclusion is a critical invariant; cheaper non-test inspection is insufficient because emitted chunks, mounts, waits, and cancellation must be measured.
Joyride v3 and Next.js 16 runtime correctness is a critical invariant; cheaper non-test inspection is insufficient because lifecycle, import, recovery, and bundle contracts must execute.
Safe protected return intent is a critical invariant; cheaper non-test inspection is insufficient because login, callback, setup, terms, sanitization, and reauthorization paths must execute.
Estimate Sheet comprehension and transfer are critical beta invariants; cheaper source inspection cannot prove that a user performs, saves, and later repeats the required editor actions.

Starter manifest cardinality/scope, exact auto-install eligibility, protected default-folder resolution, asset claims, resumable installation, inactive-key restore, shared-membership revision closure across every eligible user, role-downgrade-safe starter-organization cleanup, the closed successful Project/Estimate operation set, explicit practice identity/binding, concurrency, and generated-versus-user origin separation are critical invariants; cheaper inspection cannot prove real writes, races, bounded resume, partial recovery, no-false-complete behavior, narrower-progress preservation, non-overwrite, stale-receipt exclusion, archives, negative action cases, or event classification.

Client links guided publishing and atomic same-publication/run completion are critical MVP invariants. Cheaper non-test source inspection is insufficient because it cannot prove manager-only eligibility, verified non-empty publication scope, HMAC receipt correlation and cross-project/replay rejection, copy or authenticated Preview completion, failure/mobile recovery, public-route exclusion, or the absence of sensitive publication and recipient data from instructional state.

decisions.rationale: A short orientation, domain checklist, one task-based Estimate Sheet curriculum, and route-local guides reach value and comprehension without a brittle whole-application grand tour.
Current Joyride v3 uncontrolled mode avoids external numeric-index drift and keeps the library state machine authoritative during a run.
Business activation, generated sample value, user-origin tutorial practice, and independent transfer must remain distinguishable regardless of instructional UI exposure.
User, workspace, semantic flow, and version form the smallest durable scope that supports resume, upgrades, and tenant isolation.
One state table and one append-only event table provide idempotency and diagnostics without creating a parallel workflow platform.
Rendering components can keep semantic target identifiers stable while allowing internal markup and responsive layout to evolve.
Route-local guides bound readiness, cancellation, recovery, and ownership better than one monolithic cross-route tour.
Authoritative project, estimate, activation, and total facts complete real value tasks, while tutorial-seed writes remain classified and cannot manufacture practice or independent activation.
Mobile onboarding cannot truthfully target desktop-only navigation, so shared authorized mobile navigation is a prerequisite.
Pausing the tour before an application modal opens prevents nested focus traps and ambiguous Escape or restoration behavior.
Resume, replay, restart, checklist reopen, and reset have different persistence consequences and therefore require distinct commands and copy.
Semantic allowlisted telemetry supports recovery while excluding tenant content, resource identifiers, selectors, URLs, and free-form errors.
The archived Supabase-era plan contains superseded architecture and cannot be executable authority for the current D1 application.
Unrequested product tests remain explicit proposals and evidence gaps rather than artificial authorization or technical blockers.
Current workspace, project, and estimate grants all confer legitimate access and must work without synthetic workspace membership.
Sanitized protected return intent preserves user context without enabling open redirects, token exposure, nested auth loops, or authorization bypass.

One shared bounded Tutorial makes the starter workspace immediately legible; an explicit per-user practice Project derived from the immutable blueprint teaches hierarchy and row variety without silently duplicating Projects for joining editors.
Closed user-origin price/save and add/source predicates plus a separate non-starter transfer signal are stronger comprehension evidence than generated totals or tooltip completion.
The earlier user-created-only reusable-asset decision was explicitly superseded by the user's 2026-07-23 direction to install a bounded default starter workspace.

A closed shared 3-Project/4-Estimate-Sheet/6-Component/3-Template starter manifest makes product organization and reuse concrete while exact auto-install eligibility, two claimed custom folders, scoped claims, shared-membership revision closure, role-downgrade-safe starter-organization cleanup, explicit inactive-key restore, no silent per-user Project duplication, the closed successful checklist-operation set, and seed-origin exclusion prevent clutter, stranded group membership, retained-progress erasure, overwrite, duplication, or false activation.

One route-local Estimate Sheet Core/Optional learning rail with eight independently resumable, action-handoff lessons teaches the complete live hierarchy, row math, save/recovery behavior, reusable structure, read-only use, and transfer without turning onboarding into one long tour or mistaking tooltip views for product mastery.

Client links is a manager-only guided MVP whose core completion is emitted by one server-correlated bridge only after a verified non-empty create or republish and copy, selectable-link fallback, or authenticated Preview against the exact same current publication in the same active run; a short-lived HMAC receipt binds that relationship without persisting resource identifiers, while public recipient routes, publication tokens, recipient data, automatic email, and destructive link actions remain outside instructional state and required onboarding.
